    AI Overview
    Geno Auriemma has won 12 NCAA Division I women's basketball national championships as head coach of the UConn Huskies (1995, 2000, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2009, 2010, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2025). He holds the record for the most national championships in college basketball history, surpassing both John Wooden (10) and Pat Summitt (8). 
    • Total Titles: 12 NCAA National Championships.
    • Final Four Appearances: 24 times.
    • Key Achievement: He has led UConn to 21 conference regular season titles and 20 conference tournament titles.
    • Era of Success:
      His championships span across four different decades.
